name: sp-outline
title_zh: 只出学生作业级PPT大纲，不碰可编辑文件
tagline_zh: 期末汇报、课程展示前，把脑子里的零散想法整理成结构清晰的幻灯片大纲。它只认学生身份，不接商业路演。
tagline_en: For term papers and class talks: turns scattered ideas into a structured slide outline. Refuses corporate decks.
desc_en: Use only for a clearly student-owned academic context when the user explicitly requests a PPT or slide outline, not an editable deck. Do not use for generic presentations, standalone scripts, Q&A-only work, or non-student tasks.
why_zh: 它把「做PPT」拆成「先想清楚讲什么」，用学术语境过滤掉花哨模板，逼你先把论点、证据、结论排成一条线。
why_en: It splits 'making slides' into 'thinking first', filters out flashy templates via academic context, and forces you to line up.
limit_zh: 只认明确的学生作业场景，且只输出大纲文本，不生成任何可编辑的PPT文件。非学术汇报、商业演示、纯问答或非学生任务。
limit_en: Only student-owned academic contexts; outputs outline text only, never editable decks. Non-academic talks, scripts, Q&A-only, or non-student tasks.
title_en: Student-only PPT outline generator, no editable decks
